counterfactualIdentityEquivalentCountIfA.note: Diagnostic only: original exact 九格小食 plus two likely alias-equivalent slots. This is not a revised benchmark score and does not change frozen predictions. BLIND_REP-02_s01 would still retain a real quality disagreement (Gemini red vs canonical/GPT blue).

comparisonInterpretation.interpretation: Two of the ten prior non-exact slots are likely evaluation-protocol/name-namespace problems rather than different visual object recognition. The other eight are target-selection or item-recognition conflicts supported against Gemini by bbox geometry and canonical SOT.

evidence.crop: The crop contains several small neighboring gems, but its center is on the large green costumed-figure card.
evidence.sourceAndBbox: The bbox center (1808,544) lies inside the 3x3 green card, not on a Heart Hunter toy.
evidence.canonicalSot: The red-and-cream figure, gold side tassels, sparkles, and 3x3 footprint exactly match image5-0-2 新口味上市！. The catalog Heart Hunter L3 references are armored rider figures with different colors and silhouettes.

slotArbitrations.semanticAliasAssessment: 心猎铁骑L3 has multiple canonical family variants but no authoritative mapping to a red item; none visually matches this bbox target.

evidence.sourceAndBbox: The bbox center (1696,352) lies inside the large 4x5 gold sculpture; a bottle card is only adjacent at the left edge.
evidence.canonicalSot: The full source sculpture's gold figure and twin gray rock masses exactly match image26-0-0 乔望尼金雕像. No potion candidate matches the target area.

slotArbitrations.semanticAliasAssessment: 红药水 may describe the adjacent bottle, but the current evidence is insufficient to map purple_hongyaoshui to a unique catalog item.

evidence.canonicalSot: The loop and black marble-like base exactly match image22-1-2 环的冥思. A ticket-like blue item is nearby but is not the bbox target.

slotArbitrations.semanticAliasAssessment: gold_jinwan is a strong semantic alias candidate for the adjacent canonical 鎏金盂, with incorrect Gemini quality metadata; it does not make this slot equivalent.

aliasCandidates.evidence: Unique red 1x1 pale-blue teardrop icon, gradient, and silhouette match exactly; no catalog entry named 炽心水滴 exists.
The complete unique 5x5 fish icon is an exact visual match; catalog_065 has no 赤尾鱼 entry. Gemini quality red conflicts with canonical blue.
The neighboring round wooden top and dark pedestal match the unique 2x1 canonical table. It is adjacent to, not centered in, the audited bbox; Gemini quality green conflicts with canonical blue.
The nearby gold lidded vessel is a close, unique visual match to 鎏金盂. It is outside the audited target and Gemini quality gold conflicts with canonical green.
The neighboring green-yellow swirl marble matches the unique canonical marble icon. It is outside the audited bbox and Gemini quality green conflicts with canonical gray.
A nearby blue rectangular ticket/box resembles the canonical painkiller package, but the small rendering does not support an authoritative identity assertion and the names/qualities conflict.
The nearby off-white oval matches the canonical soap icon, but Gemini's descriptive name and white quality are inconsistent with the green canonical card.
